title: HB1575 (2025 Regular Session): Modifies the offense of unlawful possession of a firearm to include any minor possessing a firearm on public property

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.070 (RSMo): A person commits the offense of unlawful possession of a firearm if such person knowingly has any firearm in his or her possession and: (2) Such person is a fugitive from justice, is habitually in an intoxicated or drugged condition, or is currently adjudged mentally incompetent; or (3) Such person is under eighteen years of age and is on public property. However, possession under this subdivision is not an offense if such person possesses the firearm: (a) While accompanied by a person twenty-one years of age or older; (b) For the purposes of a school-sanctioned, firearm-related event or club event; (c) For the lawful pursuit of game; or (d) As otherwise authorized by law.
Section 571.070 (RSMo): 2. Unlawful possession of a firearm is a class C felony, unless a person has been convicted of a dangerous felony as defined in section 556.061, or the person has a prior conviction for unlawful possession of a firearm in which case it is a class B felony.
